description: List all objects this Sim has claimed as 'mine'. Prerequisite: none. Effect: returns an array of claim records from the persona's persistent state, one per previously claimed object_id. Claims are per-persona (this Sim's claims only) and survive sidecar and session restarts. An empty claims array is normal for a newly-created persona. Cost: none. NOT a FreeSO wire action — reads the sidecar's local claim store only. Use claim to add or update a claim.
common_mistakes: Expecting to see other Sims' claims — query-claims returns only this persona's claims. Each Sim has its own independent claim store.
Assuming the claims list reflects engine ownership — claims are sidecar-side markers only and are not enforced by the FreeSO VM.
